desc: A fault-prone operation proven safe compiles clean (no runtime check needed).
exercise: field Qty as positive integer; on E -> set R = Total / Qty

desc: When proof fails the compiler emits a diagnostic and the author must fix source before a model is produced (no silent pass).
exercise: field Divisor as integer; on E -> set R = Total / Divisor

desc: The engine proves, rejects, or leaves explicitly unresolved — it never approximates hidden certainty; unprovable operation rejects.
exercise: field N as integer; on E -> set R = 100 / N   // no modifier, no guard

desc: Quantity-dependent proof obligations are exact for supported business-domain UCUM units (decimal magnitudes, no float drift).
exercise: field W as quantity in 'kg' min '0 kg' max '100 kg'; on E -> set W = '50 kg'

desc: Logarithmic/reference-level units (dB, [pH]) are outside the exact-proof guarantee — obligations over them are not provably exact.
exercise: field L as quantity in 'dB'; on E -> set R = L + L   // outside proof guarantee

desc: Division by a non-zero literal divisor discharges (Literal proof).
exercise: on E -> set R = X / 2

desc: Division by a literal zero divisor is a proven violation.
exercise: on E -> set R = X / 0

desc: Division by an unconstrained field with no guard/modifier is not statically decidable → reject (unprovable=reject).
exercise: field Divisor as integer; on E -> set R = Total / Divisor

desc: A `when Divisor != 0` guard in the enclosing row discharges the divisor obligation (Guard-in-path).
exercise: on Calculate when Divisor != 0 -> set Rate = Total / Divisor

desc: A `when Divisor > 0` guard subsumes `!= 0` and discharges the divisor obligation.
exercise: on Submitted when Quantity > 0 -> set Rate = Amount / Quantity

desc: A `positive` modifier on the divisor field discharges the divisor obligation (Declaration-attribute proof).
exercise: field Divisor as positive integer; on Calculate -> set Result = Total / Divisor

desc: A `nonzero` modifier on the divisor field discharges the divisor obligation.
exercise: field Divisor as nonzero integer; on E -> set R = Total / Divisor

desc: A division whose divisor is unproven, appearing in a rule condition, rejects (context: rule expression).
exercise: field Divisor as integer; rule Check: Total / Divisor > 0 because "..."

desc: A division with an unproven divisor in an ensure condition rejects (context: ensure expression).
exercise: field Divisor as integer; ensure in Draft: Total / Divisor > 0 because "..."

desc: A division with an unproven divisor in a computed-field expression rejects (context: computed field).
exercise: field Divisor as integer; field Rate as number <- Total / Divisor

desc: A guard fact is invalidated by a full-replacement write before the division; the divisor obligation after the reassignment rejects.
exercise: on E when X != 0 -> set X = 0; set R = 100 / X

desc: A subtraction divisor `Z/(A-B)` under `when A > B` discharges (A>B implies A-B>0, no sign knowledge needed).
exercise: on E when A > B -> set R = Z / (A - B)

desc: A bare-field divisor `Z/A` under `when A > B` is NOT provable (both could be negative) → reject.
exercise: on E when A > B -> set R = Z / A

desc: A relational rule that empties the divisor's declared interval (e.g. X>=Y with X max 5, Y min 10) contributes no discharge fact; the dependent division rejects at its own Error.
exercise: field X as integer max 5; field Y as integer min 10; rule R: X >= Y because "..."; on E -> set Q = Z / X

desc: Modulo by a non-zero literal discharges.
exercise: on E -> set R = X % 2

desc: Modulo by a literal zero is a proven violation (the folder refuses to evaluate through modulo-by-zero, same guard as division).
exercise: on E -> set R = X % 0

desc: Modulo by an unconstrained field with no guard/modifier is not statically decidable → reject.
exercise: field Divisor as integer; on E -> set R = X % Divisor

desc: A `when Divisor != 0` guard discharges the modulo divisor obligation.
exercise: on E when Divisor != 0 -> set R = X % Divisor

desc: sqrt of a non-negative literal discharges (Literal proof).
exercise: on E -> set R = sqrt(4)

desc: sqrt of a negative literal is a proven violation.
exercise: on E -> set R = sqrt(-1)

desc: sqrt of an unconstrained field with no guard/modifier is not statically decidable → reject.
exercise: field Value as decimal; on E -> set Root = sqrt(Value)

desc: A `when Value >= 0` guard discharges the sqrt non-negative obligation.
exercise: on Process when Value >= 0 -> set Root = sqrt(Value)

desc: A `nonnegative` modifier on the operand field discharges the sqrt obligation.
exercise: field Value as nonnegative decimal; on E -> set Root = sqrt(Value)

desc: sqrt(abs(X)) discharges because abs's overload declares ReturnNonnegative (FunctionReturnSatisfies), no intermediate modifier needed.
exercise: field X as decimal; on E -> set Root = sqrt(abs(X))

desc: sqrt of an unproven operand in a computed-field expression rejects (context: computed field).
exercise: field Value as decimal; field Root as number <- sqrt(Value)

desc: pow with a non-negative integer literal exponent discharges the exponent obligation.
exercise: field X as decimal; on E -> set R = pow(X, 2)

desc: pow with a negative integer literal exponent is a proven violation of the `exp >= 0` obligation.
exercise: field X as decimal; on E -> set R = pow(X, -1)

desc: pow with an unconstrained integer exponent field is not statically decidable → reject.
exercise: field N as integer; field X as decimal; on E -> set R = pow(X, N)

desc: A `when N >= 0` guard discharges the pow exponent obligation.
exercise: field N as integer; field X as decimal; on E when N >= 0 -> set R = pow(X, N)

desc: A computed field over bounded operands whose result interval fits its own declared bounds discharges (IntervalContainment).
exercise: field A as integer min 0 max 100; field B as integer min 0 max 100; field Avg as integer min 0 max 100 <- (A + B) / 2

desc: A computed field with unbounded operands into a bounded field stays Unresolved and surfaces NumericOverflow (not vacuously satisfied).
exercise: field A as integer; field B as integer; field Sum as integer min 0 max 100 <- A + B

desc: A set-action assigning a provably in-range value to a min/max-bounded field discharges.
exercise: field Level as integer min 0 max 10; on E when Level < 5 -> set Level = Level + 1

desc: A set-action whose result interval exceeds the target field's declared bounds emits NumericOverflow.
exercise: field Level as integer min 0 max 10; on E -> set Level = Level + 100

desc: A numeric element written into a collection whose inner type declares min/max, in range, discharges the per-element containment obligation.
exercise: field Scores as set of integer min 0 max 100; on E -> add Scores 50

desc: A numeric element written into a bounded-inner-type collection out of range emits NumericOverflow.
exercise: field Scores as set of integer min 0 max 100; on E -> add Scores 500

desc: A field default within its declared min/max discharges the default value-bound obligation.
exercise: field X as integer min 0 max 10 default 5

desc: A field default violating a declared value-bounding modifier surfaces OutOfRange.
exercise: field X as integer min 0 max 10 default 20

desc: A `positive` field with default 0 violates the positive lower bound → OutOfRange.
exercise: field X as positive integer default 0

desc: A genuinely unresolvable default magnitude is conservatively not range-checked (no false rejection).
exercise: field A as integer; field X as integer min 0 max 10 default A   // non-constant default

desc: An event-arg default violating a declared bound surfaces OutOfRange (context: arg default).
exercise: on E(n as integer min 0 max 10 default 99) -> set X = n

desc: first() of a non-empty collection literal discharges the non-empty requirement.
exercise: on E -> set FirstItem = first([1, 2, 3])

desc: first([]) of an empty collection literal is a proven violation.
exercise: on E -> set FirstItem = first([])

desc: first(Items) on an unconstrained collection field with no guard is not statically decidable → reject.
exercise: field Items as list of integer; on E -> set FirstItem = first(Items)

desc: A `when count(Items) > 0` guard discharges the non-empty requirement on first(Items).
exercise: on Submitted when count(Items) > 0 -> set FirstItem = first(Items)

desc: A `when Items.count > 0` member-access guard discharges the non-empty requirement.
exercise: on E when Items.count > 0 -> set FirstItem = first(Items)

desc: last(Items) on an unguarded collection is not statically decidable → reject.
exercise: field Items as list of integer; on E -> set LastItem = last(Items)

desc: Queue/stack .peek on an unguarded collection is not statically decidable → reject.
exercise: field Q as queue of integer; on E -> set Head = Q.peek

desc: A statically-literal mincount N (N>=1) discharges collection non-empty access requirements.
exercise: field Items as list of integer mincount 1; on E -> set FirstItem = first(Items)

desc: A prior grow in the action chain establishes count>0, discharging a following accessor (CollectionGrowth Strategy 11).
exercise: field Items as list of integer; on E -> add Items 1; set FirstItem = first(Items)

desc: dequeue on an unguarded queue is not statically decidable → UnguardedCollectionMutation.
exercise: field Q as queue of integer; on E -> dequeue Q

desc: pop on an unguarded stack is not statically decidable → UnguardedCollectionMutation.
exercise: field S as stack of integer; on E -> pop S

desc: A `when Q.count > 0` guard discharges the dequeue non-empty mutation obligation.
exercise: field Q as queue of integer; on E when Q.count > 0 -> dequeue Q

desc: An enqueue before a dequeue establishes count>0, discharging the dequeue (Strategy 11).
exercise: field Q as queue of integer; on E -> enqueue Q 1; dequeue Q

desc: A pre-shrink count>0 guard does not discharge a count>0 obligation after a shrink; the second dequeue rejects.
exercise: field Q as queue of integer; on E when Q.count > 0 -> dequeue Q; dequeue Q

desc: A lookup key access with no guard establishing key presence is not statically decidable → reject (KeyPresence via guard-derived bounds).
exercise: field M as lookup of string to integer; on E -> set V = M['k']

desc: A guard establishing key presence discharges the key-lookup obligation.
exercise: field M as lookup of string to integer; on E when M contains 'k' -> set V = M['k']

desc: An indexed access with no guard establishing the index is within bounds is not statically decidable → reject (IndexBounds via guard-derived bounds).
exercise: field Items as list of integer; field I as integer; on E -> set V = Items.at(I)

desc: A guard establishing the index is within collection bounds discharges the index-bounds obligation.
exercise: field Items as list of integer; field I as integer; on E when I >= 0 and I < Items.count -> set V = Items.at(I)

desc: Access to an optional field with no presence guard is not statically decidable → UnprovedPresenceRequirement.
exercise: field Note as optional string; on E -> set Copy = Note

desc: A `when Note is set` guard discharges the presence requirement.
exercise: field Note as optional string; on E when Note is set -> set Copy = Note

desc: A non-optional field carries a Guaranteed presence carrier — access discharges without a guard.
exercise: field Name as string; on E -> set Copy = Name

desc: notempty does NOT satisfy presence — an optional notempty field may still be absent → reject.
exercise: field Note as optional string notempty; on E -> set Copy = Note

desc: A `clear` full-replacement write invalidates a prior presence guard; the following access rejects.
exercise: field X as optional integer; on E when X is set -> clear X; set R = X + 1

desc: A source bounded to maxlength N assigned into a destination of maxlength >= N discharges (length carries through composition).
exercise: field Src as string maxlength 5; field Dest as string maxlength 10; on E -> set Dest = Src

desc: A string literal whose exact length fits the declared minlength/maxlength discharges.
exercise: field Code as string minlength 2 maxlength 5; on E -> set Code = 'abc'

desc: A string literal whose length exceeds maxlength is a proven violation → LengthBoundViolation.
exercise: field Code as string maxlength 3; on E -> set Code = 'abcdef'

desc: An unbounded string source assigned into a capped field is unprovable (unbounded interval) → LengthBoundViolation (prove-or-reject).
exercise: field Src as string; field Dest as string maxlength 10; on E -> set Dest = Src

desc: A concatenation whose summed length interval fits the destination bounds discharges.
exercise: field A as string maxlength 3; field B as string maxlength 3; field Dest as string maxlength 10; on E -> set Dest = A + B

desc: A concatenation whose summed length interval can exceed the destination maxlength rejects.
exercise: field A as string maxlength 8; field B as string maxlength 8; field Dest as string maxlength 10; on E -> set Dest = A + B

desc: An unbounded string introduced into a collection whose inner type declares maxlength rejects when not provably within the element bound.
exercise: field Names as queue of string maxlength 200; field N as string; on E -> enqueue Names N

desc: A string field default violating the declared minlength/maxlength surfaces LengthBoundViolation.
exercise: field Code as string minlength 3 default 'a'

desc: A guarded grow that provably keeps count within maxcount discharges the count-containment obligation.
exercise: field C as list of integer maxcount 5; on E when C.count < 5 -> add C 1

desc: Two grows into maxcount 1 push the count interval past the cap → CountBoundViolation.
exercise: field C as list of integer maxcount 1; on E -> add C 1; add C 2

desc: An unguarded grow whose upper bound was infinity-seeded is unprovable (post-hi = maxcount+1) → CountBoundViolation (no runtime deferral).
exercise: field C as list of integer maxcount 5; on E -> add C 1

desc: A shrink that can drop count below mincount rejects.
exercise: field C as list of integer mincount 1; on E -> removeAt C 0

desc: Two adds into a dedup set maxcount 1 use +0 lower / +1 upper deltas; a guarded/room case discharges but an over-cap dedup chain is not falsely proved.
exercise: field C as set of integer maxcount 1; on E -> add C 1; add C 1

desc: A `default [...]` literal whose exact element count exceeds maxcount rejects.
exercise: field C as list of integer maxcount 2 default [1, 2, 3]

desc: money of same currency added discharges the qualifier-compatibility obligation.
exercise: field A as money of 'USD'; field B as money of 'USD'; on E -> set S = A + B

desc: money of differing currencies added is a proven incompatibility → UnprovedQualifierCompatibility.
exercise: field A as money of 'USD'; field B as money of 'EUR'; on E -> set S = A + B

desc: quantity of same unit added discharges.
exercise: field A as quantity in 'kg'; field B as quantity in 'kg'; on E -> set S = A + B

desc: quantity of differing units added → UnprovedQualifierCompatibility.
exercise: field A as quantity in 'kg'; field B as quantity in 'miles'; on E -> set S = A + B

desc: Unqualified quantity + quantity cannot be proven compatible → reject.
exercise: field A as quantity; field B as quantity; on E -> set S = A + B

desc: KNOWN GAP: price x quantity currently cancels for same-dimension but different-unit operands, silently dropping the UCUM conversion factor (unsound); doc flags this as undecided.
exercise: field P as price in 'USD/kg'; field Q as quantity in 'g'; on E -> set M = P * Q

desc: A quantity x quantity product landing in the curated business-domain dimension set discharges.
exercise: field L as quantity in 'm'; field W as quantity in 'm'; on E -> set Area = L * W

desc: A cancelling pair (kg x 1/kg -> count) resolves to the dimensionless count alias and discharges.
exercise: field A as quantity in 'kg'; field B as quantity in '/kg'; on E -> set N = A * B

desc: A product outside the curated set (kg x m -> mass*length) fails to discharge → IncompatibleDimensionalProduct.
exercise: field A as quantity in 'kg'; field B as quantity in 'm'; on E -> set X = A * B

desc: A period operand with a declared/derived required dimension satisfies the dimension requirement.
exercise: field D as period in 'days'; on E -> set Later = Start + D

desc: An open period whose dimension axis is narrowed by a `when X.dimension == 'date'` guard satisfies the dimension requirement.
exercise: field P as period; on E when P.dimension == 'date' -> set Later = Start + P

desc: A period operand lacking the required dimension is not statically decidable → UnprovedDimensionRequirement.
exercise: field P as period; on E -> set Later = Start + P

desc: PeriodDimension.Any (unqualified period, locked decision) permissively satisfies any dimension requirement.
exercise: field P as period; on E -> set X = duration(P)   // Any satisfies dimension proof

desc: A field that declares the required modifier satisfies a ModifierRequirement (direct membership).
exercise: field X as nonnegative integer; on E -> set R = requiresNonnegative(X)

desc: A field lacking the required modifier cannot satisfy a ModifierRequirement → UnprovedModifierRequirement.
exercise: field X as integer; on E -> set R = requiresNonnegative(X)

desc: Initial-state ensure satisfied by declared defaults discharges (no violation).
exercise: field X as integer default 10; state Draft initial; ensure in Draft: X > 5 because "..."

desc: An initial-state ensure provably false under declared defaults → UnsatisfiableInitialState.
exercise: field X as integer default 0; state Draft initial; ensure in Draft: X > 5 because "..."

desc: An unfoldable/non-literal default folds to Unknown → conservative pass (no false rejection).
exercise: field Y as integer; field X as integer <- Y + 1; state Draft initial; ensure in Draft: X > 5 because "..."

desc: A guarded initial-state ensure is skipped (treated as vacuously satisfiable) — no rejection.
exercise: field X as integer default 0; state Draft initial; ensure in Draft when X > 100: X > 5 because "..."

desc: A precept with an initial construction handler suppresses the rule/ensure-vs-default fold (placeholders overwritten), avoiding over-rejection.
exercise: field X as integer default 0; state Draft initial; on initial(v as integer) -> set X = v; ensure in Draft: X > 5 because "..."

desc: A global unguarded rule provably false against the field default environment → DefaultViolatesRule.
exercise: field X as integer default 0; rule Positive: X > 5 because "..."

desc: A rule over a computed/non-constant/unknown default folds to null and never rejects (prove-or-reject: emit only on proven false).
exercise: field Y as integer; field X as integer <- Y; rule Positive: X > 5 because "..."

desc: A `when`-guarded rule is skipped by the rule-vs-default fold (not an unconditional invariant).
exercise: field X as integer default 0; field Flag as boolean default false; rule Positive when Flag: X > 5 because "..."

desc: A transition-row guard unsatisfiable under declared field bounds emits UnsatisfiableGuard (the row can never fire).
exercise: field X as integer min 0 max 5; on E when X > 10 -> set Y = 1

desc: A transition-row guard tautological under declared field bounds emits TautologicalGuard.
exercise: field X as integer min 0 max 5; on E when X < 10 -> set Y = 1

desc: A rule impossible on its own field-declared bounds (empty interval) emits UnsatisfiableRule.
exercise: field X as integer min 0 max 5; rule Impossible: X > 10 because "..."

desc: A rule whose predicate is provably-true under field bounds emits VacuousRule.
exercise: field X as integer min 0 max 5; rule Always: X < 100 because "..."

desc: Two rules whose interval intersection on a shared field is empty emit ContradictoryRule.
exercise: field X as integer; rule Lo: X < 5 because "..."; rule Hi: X > 10 because "..."

desc: Every declared constraint with proof semantics produces an obligation on every applicable mutation path (Obligation Generation Contract) — a minlength field's assignment is checked.
exercise: field X as string minlength 3; field Src as string; on E -> set X = Src

desc: A maxcount-declared collection produces a count-containment obligation on every growing mutation (Obligation Generation Contract).
exercise: field C as set of string maxcount 10; field V as string; on E -> add C V

desc: When the compiler cannot prove a computed value stays inside its declared limit it rejects the definition rather than deferring to a runtime check (prove-or-reject MVP).
exercise: field A as integer; field Capped as integer min 0 max 100 <- A

desc: When an obligation cannot be discharged the compiler rejects AND names what would make the operation provably safe (remediation guidance in the diagnostic).
exercise: field Divisor as integer; on E -> set R = Total / Divisor   // diagnostic should name the guard/modifier that discharges

desc: A bound requiring transitive combination of two separate facts (allocations<=commitments + commitments<=plan) is out of scope — single-hop only — so it stays unproven and rejects.
exercise: field Alloc as integer; field Commit as integer; field Plan as integer; rule R1: Alloc <= Commit because "..."; rule R2: Commit <= Plan because "..."; on E -> set R = Plan / (Plan - Alloc)

desc: General dataflow across transitions is out of scope — a value made safe only by a prior transition's action is not tracked, so a dependent fault-prone op in a later transition rejects.
exercise: state A initial; state B; on Setup from A to B -> set X = 5; on Use from B -> set R = Total / X

desc: An obligation whose site contains a type-error operand emits NO proof diagnostic (root cause already reported upstream; no cascading proof diagnostic).
exercise: field Divisor as integer; on E -> set R = Total / (Divisor + undefinedName)

desc: A transition originating from an unreachable state has its proof obligations vacuously satisfied (the transition can never fire) — no proof diagnostic from that row.
exercise: state A initial; state Orphan; state B; on E from Orphan to B -> set R = Total / 0

desc: The proof engine runs for stateless precepts — a fault-prone op in an event handler still rejects when unproven.
exercise: field Divisor as integer; on Compute -> set R = Total / Divisor   // stateless, no states
